title: Compute polycrystalline transformation strain from lattice constants
action: For each of the five Ti contents (49.0, 49.6, 50.0, 50.6, 51.0 at.%), use the provided B2 and B19' lattice constants to construct the lattice-distortion matrix T' in martensite coordinates, transform to parent coordinates via T = R T' R^t using the given orthogonal matrix R, compute the directional transformation strain ε_M^i = (|x'|-|x|)/|x| for each of the 36 deterministically generated orientations (see Approach for the exact grid), and average the 36 values to obtain ε̄_M. Write the five resulting ε̄_M values to a CSV file.
description: Table of computed polycrystalline transformation strain ε̄_M for each Ti content.
output_schema: Columns: Ti_content (float, at.%), epsilon_bar_M (float, strain). Five rows, one per Ti content.
